Definition: from G2596 and G1377; to hunt down, i.e. search for:--follow after.
BiblicalUsage: Simon and those with him followed after Jesus, hunting Him down in the early morning to tell Him everyone was looking for Him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the disciples had the right instinct, even when they had the wrong idea of what He should do next.
